text:
anya: heads up — multiple customers reporting p95/p99 spikes on /v1/chat for long-context prompts (>8k). started after last kernel-heuristics rollout.
support_jason: ACME and Beacon both sent support tickets, numbers: p99 ~2.8x baseline, p95 ~1.6x. seeing errors only on summaries >1024 output tokens.
sahil: pulling kernel-selection traces now. early look shows a sharp increase in SDPA->generic fallback for batches with long prefix lengths, and a higher KV cache eviction rate. attaching selection log in a sec.
morgan: do we know which compile flags/variants were active during the rollout? need the exact kernel priority matrix.
deploy-bot: rollout completed: kernel-heuristics v3.4.1 to cluster us-west-2 at 2026-03-16T04:12Z (deploy id: dpl-8973).
infra-bot: alert: p99 latency for redwood-open-7b-chat in us-west-2 increased by 2.9x at 2026-03-16T04:15Z; error rate unchanged.
sahil: paste of relevant snippet from kernel-selection debug stream:
```
[2026-03-16T04:13:02Z] model=redwood-open-7b-chat seq_prefix=8200 kernels_considered=[sdpa_fast, sdpa_stable, flashpref, generic] selected=generic reason="cost_threshold_mismatch" compile_flags=["-O2","-DUSE_SDPA=1"]
[2026-03-16T04:13:02Z] fallback_count++ sbatch=3 kv_evictions=0.12
```

devon: repro plan I'm running locally: 1) seed model on canary 2) craft prompt ~9k context (mix of long instructions + chat) 3) send 1k requests at qps=5 to approximate customer pattern. will forward perf histograms.
morgan: also capture `kvcache_hit_ratio`, `batch_size_dist`, and `kernel_select_prob` while reproing.
support_jason: customer follow-up: they can tolerate slightly higher throughput if p99 drops below 1.2x baseline. asking ETA.
anya: immediate mitigations: 1) toggle heuristic that deprioritizes SDPA for long prefixes (prefer-sdpa=true) on canary 2) pin compile flags to previous stable build (rollback -DUSE_SDPA variant) 3) enable sticky kernel routing for active sessions to avoid misroutes.
sahil: I can push a canary hotpatch to revert the priority matrix for longseq heuristics. steps: 
```
rbx kernel-config set --cluster us-west-2 --matrix revert-longseq-priority --dry-run && 
rbx kernel-config apply --cluster us-west-2 --matrix revert-longseq-priority --canary 5%
```
I'll stream logs to this thread.
morgan: if canary is green for 10m, escalate to 50% then full. watch p95/p99 and KV eviction.
anya: @devon can you coordinate with infra to hold off autoscaling adjustments while we validate? autoscale could mask root cause.
devon: will do — pausing any scale actions for us-west-2 for the next 30m.
infra-bot: note: autoscaler paused for cluster us-west-2 by devon at 2026-03-16T04:28Z.
support_jason: relaying ETA to ACME: canary toggle in ~15m, wider rollback within ~45m if metrics look good.
anya: good. next steps: sahil run canary hotpatch, devon pause autoscale, morgan collect metrics, support_jason keep customer posted. log any anomalies here. :thumbsup:
